sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Uncensored-Genesis-Hermes-V7-GGUF is a 35-billion parameter mixture-of-experts language model created by LuffyTheFox that applies a post-training tensor repair technique called Genesis to reduce accumulated training noise without retraining.
